name: smart-ai-automation-complaint-platform
description: Smart AI Automation Complaint Platform — monorepo root

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,ai-service -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,client,ai-service -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client" "npm run start:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run setup:ai
